scripts.dev: npm run build:main && concurrently -k "vite" "wait-on tcp:5173 && env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
scripts.package: npm run build && npm run prepare:universal && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.js --mac --universal --publish never
